title: Lateral-hunt coverage — identity compromise
summary: Share of identity_compromise incidents where the lateral-movement hunt was performed against authentication telemetry within the configured lookback window. Higher is better — drops when the hunt step is skipped or fails to observe enough authentication evidence.

target.rationale: A skipped lateral hunt leaves residual persistence; coverage below 0.95 is treated as an investigation gap.

measurement.formula: count(incidents whose lateral_hunt_and_iam_audit step queried authentication telemetry) / count(incidents reaching the hunt step) over window.

inputs.name: hunts_run
inputs.description: completions of the lateral-hunt + IAM-audit step

inputs.name: events
inputs.description: authentication events observed during the hunt window

external_refs.name: DORA Regulation Article 17 — ICT-related incident management
